_note: Harm-class table (XII.2 item 1). Each row is a published exposure or immunity threshold below which the harm does not occur; commission.py turns it, with the installation's meter, into an exclusion radius. Thresholds are protective limits, far below injury, so the radii are conservative. Rows sharing a group are alternative sufficient tests for one harm: the group passes when any of its rows passes.

harm_classes.name: human body, RF heating (whole body)
harm_classes.source: ICNIRP 2020 general-public reference level, 30-400 MHz (the most stringent band), 30-min average; Health Physics 118(5):483-524

harm_classes.name: human body, RF heating, per-channel meter
harm_classes.source: ICNIRP 2020 as above, with the measured radiated RF power as the channel meter

harm_classes.name: human body, RF heating at body contact (certified SAR)
harm_classes.source: FCC localized SAR limit, 1.6 W/kg over 1 g (47 CFR 1.1310); device value from the manufacturer's RF exposure report, radios at highest transmission level, body contact

harm_classes.name: electronic devices and records (radiated immunity, residential)
electronic devices and records (radiated immunity, residential), radio meter
harm_classes.source: IEC 61000-4-3 test level 2 (3 V/m), with the radios' certified combined maximum output as the channel meter; unintentional emissions are certified to FCC Part 15 Class B (at most 500 microvolt/m at 3 m)

harm_classes.name: electronic devices and records (radiated immunity, industrial)
electronic devices and records (radiated immunity, industrial), radio meter
harm_classes.source: IEC 61000-4-3 test level 3 (10 V/m), with the radios' certified combined maximum output as the channel meter

harm_classes.name: hearing, impulse injury
harm_classes.source: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.95(b)(1): impulsive noise not to exceed 140 dB peak SPL (1e-12 W/m^2 x 1e14)

harm_classes.name: hearing, 8-hour exposure
harm_classes.source: NIOSH REL 85 dBA, 8-hour TWA (all metered power taken as sound: removed by excluding speakers)

harm_classes.name: skin, radiant heat
harm_classes.source: ground-level solar irradiance (~1 kW/m^2), an everyday non-injurious exposure

harm_classes.name: ionising radiation
harm_classes.source: photons below 1 keV are absorbed within millimetres of air (Henke, Gullikson and Davis 1993)

harm_classes.name: living tissue and devices, low-frequency magnetic field
harm_classes.source: ICNIRP 2010 general-public reference level at 50 Hz (200 microtesla); inverse-cube scaling

harm_classes.name: coherent quantum particulars, decoherence
harm_classes.source: per device: coupling kappa of decoherence rate to received power
